annotation.title_clean: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
annotation.title_en: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
annotation.summary_en: NIST SP 800-218A is an SSDF Community Profile augmenting SSDF 1.1 with secure development practices, tasks and recommendations specific to generative AI and dual-use foundation models, issued to support Executive Order 14110. It targets AI model producers, AI system producers and acquirers. It is voluntary guidance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Augments SSDF 1.1 with AI-model-specific practices, tasks, recommendations and notes.
Written in response to EO 14110's tasking on secure development for generative and dual-use foundation models.
Addresses AI model producers, AI system producers and AI system acquirers.
Recommends protecting training pipelines and environments, least privilege, and monitoring.
Suggests human-in-the-loop review for security checks and provenance attestations for training data.
